# gitops/workloads/

**Generated by `atlasctl enable` — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.**

- `<group>/<app>.yaml` — ArgoCD Application (generated from `workloads/<group>/<app>/app.yaml`).
- `<group>/<app>/resources/` — synced workload resources (generated from
  `workloads/<group>/<app>/{infra,monitoring,secrets.yaml}`).

To change a workload, edit `workloads/<group>/<app>/` and re-run `atlasctl enable`.
